name: Sigma Curves (hand-drawn schedule, savable as schedulers)
plain: Starts from any registered scheduler run through the stock BasicScheduler, and if the canvas widget has stored an edited curve, replaces it with that curve. The curve is a list of values in [0,1], linearly resampled to the needed length and mapped so 0 is the model's σ_min and 1 its σ_max; a trailing 0 is kept when the base schedule ends at 0 and the drawn curve ends near 0. denoise below 1 resamples to steps/denoise and keeps the tail, like BasicScheduler. Saved presets are registered at startup as new scheduler names 'sigma_curve_<name>', so a preset name like 'pchip' would sit next to PowerShift's sigma_curve_pchip in the same list.
math:
Symbols: v_j user values in [0,1]; L = int(steps/denoise) + 1; σ_min, σ_max from the model.
v' = linear resample of v to L points; keep the last steps+1 when denoise < 1; σ_k = σ_min + v'_k (σ_max − σ_min); σ_last ← 0 if base schedule ends at 0 and v'_last ≤ 1e-3.
Saved preset scheduler: same resample to steps+1 points and the same mapping, with 0 forced at the end when trailing_zero is set.

props.params: model, scheduler=normal, steps=20, denoise=1.0, curve_data (JSON from the canvas widget)
props.registers: saved presets as scheduler names with prefix sigma_curve_ (stored in the pack's presets/sigma_curves.json)
props.special_case: mirrors RES4LYF beta57 itself (beta with alpha 0.5, beta 0.7) because that name is not in SCHEDULER_HANDLERS
